headline: 🔥 THIS BOARD CALLED IT: 1709 FIELDSTONE TOOK ITS FIRST OFFER AT 3:15 THIS AFTERNOON — from the exact agent whose assistant called Monday night to ask whether he was bidding against anyone, the question this board has been flagging as the only live buyer thread on the listing for five days. hotSignals.signal: 🔥 THE SIGNAL BECAME A CONTRACT DOCUMENT. Robert B. · RealtyCore — whose assistant called Monday night to ask whether any offers were in or expected — submitted a written offer at 3:15 PM with a contract, a pre-approval letter and a personal letter from the buyers attached, then texted eleven minutes later to say so himself. ⭐ THIS IS THE EXACT AGENT AND THE EXACT PATTERN THIS BOARD FLAGGED: agents do not ask about competing offers on houses their buyers are lukewarm on. The buyers are a pair of nurses living in Helena. ⚠️ READ THE SHAPE, NOT THE HEADLINE: it is written at full list on the front with a five percent seller concession on the back, so the real number to your sellers is meaningfully below the sticker — and the buyer's commission is written above what the listing publishes.
hotSignals.action: Get your sellers on the phone tonight. Your recommended counter went to them at 4:54 — a higher price and a later closing date, deliberately longer than the buyers asked for because their new build lands inside that window — but a recommendation is not an authorization and nothing moves until they say yes. ⭐ You already pre-empted the commission gap by text and he acknowledged it, so that fight is over before it started. ⚠️ The inspection period as written is very short, and the net figures on both sides carry an unconfirmed HOA proration — do not treat either net as final in front of the sellers. ✅ No machine email went to the buyer's agent and none will: outreach stays suspended under your own ruling, and this one is yours anyway.

hotSignals.signal: ⏳ THE TOUR RAN THIS MORNING AND THE READ IS STILL NOT BACK, SIX HOURS ON. hotSignals.action: Chase it by phone tonight instead of waiting on the written form. hotSignals.action: This slid behind Fieldstone today and that was the right call, but the clock did not slide with it.
